tasks.title: Animate the admin login card with the existing Reveal layer
acceptance_criteria: Imports the existing `Reveal` default export from `src/components/Reveal.jsx`.
The login card fades/rises in via `Reveal`; its header and the form rows (two fields + submit) stagger via the `delay` (`.d1`-`.d4`) prop.

No edit to `src/index.css`. Reduced-motion/print are inherited from the global `.reveal` rules. Any login-specific keyframe (only if added) lives in `src/admin/LoginPage.css` with matching `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` + `@media print` overrides.
The card's existing classes/styling (shadow, radius, padding, fonts, colors) and layout are preserved — Reveal wraps/decorates, it does not replace the `adm-login-card` styling.
Form behavior is unchanged: `autoFocus` on username, inputs/button disabled while loading, error banner on failure, `navigate('/admin')` on success.
`src/admin/LoginPage.test.jsx` renders the page in a MemoryRouter and asserts its key copy/controls are present.
tests: LoginPage renders the 'Administration' eyebrow, the 'Météo Nicolas' title, the Identifiant and Mot de passe fields, and the 'Se connecter' submit button.
Submit button is disabled when username/password are empty (existing behavior still holds after wrapping).
`npm run test` passes; `npm run lint` and `npm run build` pass.
Manual (Verify stage): the login card fades/rises in with staggered rows; reduce-motion and print show it fully visible; login still works.

out_of_scope: Any change to src/index.css or the shared motion primitives.
Auth logic, validation, copy, layout, color, or routing changes.
Re-testing Reveal's reduced-motion / no-observer guarantees (covered in src/components/Reveal.test.jsx).
